description: Adversarial + clean inputs for evaluate_safety.py. All credentials are fabricated. 'covered' cases use the forms the Phase 8 patterns target; 'held_out' cases are common real-world forms written without reference to the patterns, so they measure coverage gaps. 'clean' cases are legitimate paper/code text that must pass untouched.
